**The native build of 1.4.0-beta.1.** It's the same code as 1.4.0-beta.1, published so panels on the **Native** channel get it. In this build the Rust agent and updater are on by default, and the agent falls back to Bun by itself if it can't start.

Testing: follow [Testing the Rust agent](https://github.com/MattA-Official/mc-panel/blob/native-1.4.0-beta.1.native.1/docs/testing/testing-rust-agent.md) on a spare VPS.
